newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open 0.05 cent weaker.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open 0.05 cent weaker.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open 0.05 cent weaker Wednesday, dealers said, as players are expected to take profits following Tuesday's climb to lifetime highs.

Fund buying bolstered the market to contract highs across the board yesterday before benchmark October eased slightly to close at 11.59 cents a lb, up 0.33 cent. Second-position March went out 0.27 cent higher at 11.77 cents after climbing to a lifetime high of 11.82 cents, while the rest gained 0.21 to 0.25 cent.
An estimated 50,565 lots changed hands Tuesday.

LIFFE white sugar futures were lower Wednesday on profit taking following an early bout of fund buying that bolstered the benchmark October contract to a new lifetime high. At 0835 EDT/1235 GMT, October was down $1.90 at $327.80. The rest were $1.30 to $0.70 lower.
